stem.en: Ice melting at room temperature absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet happens on its own. How is this consistent with spontaneity?
stem.et: Jää sulamine toatemperatuuril neelab ümbrusest soojust, ometi toimub see iseenesest. Kuidas see iseeneslikkusega kokku sobib?

label.en: The entropy increase outweighs the enthalpy cost at that temperature, making the free energy change negative
label.et: Entroopia kasv kaalub sel temperatuuril üles entalpiakulu, muutes vabaenergia muudu negatiivseks

label.en: It cannot be spontaneous, since spontaneous processes must release heat
label.et: See ei saa olla iseeneslik, sest iseeneslikud protsessid peavad soojust vabastama

label.en: Melting is spontaneous at every temperature, since spontaneity is a property of water alone
label.et: Sulamine on iseeneslik igal temperatuuril, sest iseeneslikkus on ainult vee omadus

label.en: It is spontaneous only because it happens quickly enough to observe
label.et: See on iseeneslik ainult seetõttu, et toimub piisavalt kiiresti, et seda näha
